features: Dimensity 6300 6‐nm Efficient Processor: Powered by MediaTek Dimensity 6300 octa‐core chip with Mali‐G57 MC2 GPU, paired with 8GB LPDDR4X RAM and UFS 2.2 storage. Available in 8GB+128GB /8GB+256GB variants, it supports micro‐SD card expansion for extra storage, delivering stable daily performance for streaming, social media and light gaming.

7000mAh Massive Battery with 80W SUPERVOOC Flash Charge: Built‐in huge 7000‐mAh battery for ultra‐long‐lasting daily usage. 80W SUPERVOOC fast charging brings rapid power‐up, compatible with PPS & PD charging protocols to meet flexible charging demands.

6.75‐inch 120Hz HD+ LCD Display: Large‐size 120Hz high refresh rate LCD screen with 240Hz touch sampling rate and peak brightness up to 1125 nits, offers smooth scrolling and clear viewing even under bright outdoor sunlight.

IP69 Grade Heavy‐Dust & Water‐Resistant Build: Certified with IP66, IP68 and IP69 rating, withstand high‐temperature high‐pressure water jets, immersion and dust. Equipped with 3900mm2 SuperCool VC vapor‐chamber cooling system for better heat dissipation during long‐time gaming and heavy workloads.

ColorOS 15 with 60‐Month Fluency Protection: Runs ColorOS 15 based on Android 15 with official 60‐month fluency protection to keep the system responsive for long‐term use. Support dual‐SIM 5G, USB‐OTG, in‐display fingerprint unlock and facial recognition for convenient daily operations.
description: Meet the OPPO A6 Pro 5G, a long‐life durable mid‐range smartphone built for users prioritizing huge battery capacity and rugged reliability, it is driven by MediaTek Dimensity 6300 6‐nanometer octa‐core processor matched with 8GB LPDDR4X RAM and UFS 2.2 storage, available in 8GB+128GB and 8GB+256GB configurations and supporting micro‐SD card expansion for additional storage space to satisfy daily social‐media browsing, video streaming and light‐gaming scenarios, it carries a massive 7000mAh large‐capacity battery paired with 80W SUPERVOOC flash charging which is compatible with PPS and PD protocols for convenient fast power replenishment, certified with IP66, IP68 and IP69 dust‐and‐water‐resistant rating, this handset resists high‐temperature water jets, immersion and dust interference, while the 3900mm2 SuperCool VC vapor‐chamber cooling optimizes heat dissipation for heavy‐load usage, enjoy smooth visual experience on its 6.75‐inch HD+ LCD display with 120Hz refresh rate, 240Hz touch sampling rate and peak brightness up to 1125 nits for clear outdoor viewing, running ColorOS 15 based on Android 15 with official 60‐month fluency protection to maintain long‐term system smoothness,
